notes.title: Strangers in a Strange Land - First Release Version
notes.notes:
Thank you all for supporting me !

This game has been a dream for me since I started working with programming and 3D and I am really pleased with the way it turned out. I had lots of help from the artists PBX and KALEVRA both of whom work with a website which "sponsored" the game so I wouldn't starve to death while I was working on it. 

The game contains lots of thriller scenes , but it is not "scary" in the sense that it will make you jump from your chair but rather in the sense that it will make you wonder how terrible some events could be if you promise the wrong people the worst of things. 

I hope you enjoy it and please know that I am still working on expanding it further or even creating a part 2 if I all goes well.

Thank you again!

Notes:

I am still working on polishing some parts of the game so it will run smoother but here are some known issues that you may encounter :

1. Slow loading of save files. --> This is really common , it may take up to 40-60 seconds! for a game to load but it will eventually load. I am trying to reduce it to 4-10 seconds and it is do-able but I will include the fix in the next patch (working on it)

2. Clipping - > Some animations seem to be skipping. I am working on that so they will run smoother. The good thing is that once the animations run once then they run smoothly from there on
